06 / WITH MY WHOLE HEART

dear Paru,

The bit I really wanted you to read. Slowly, if you can.

Dear Paru,

There are so many things I love about you. I love watching you laugh without holding back. I love seeing you happy, especially when it's the sort of happy that makes your eyes light up.

I love singing the baby song for you. I know I'll probably sing it a thousand more times, and I'll still want to do it again if it makes you smile. I love our silly little moments, and how something so small can feel like our own little world.

But more than any of that, I love how you are. Not just when you're dressed up and looking gorgeous, not just when you're smiling for a picture. I love the real you. The one who doesn't have to try to be anything else around me. You don't need to be different, or better, or more. Being Paru is more than enough.

I look at these pictures, from tiny Paru to the woman you are now, and I feel lucky I get to be part of your story. I hope you always feel loved, not only when things are easy, but in all the ordinary in-between moments too.

And if you ever forget how wonderful you are, come back here. I'll remind you. As many times as you need.

yours, always. ♡
♡
